summary: One-frame event of esv::inventory::InteractionSystem (Toolkit users AddToInventory, DropFromInventory, CreateMemberChanges, CreateScriptEvents ...): a set of 8-byte values (entity handles) to notify about for an inventory. bg3.exe+0x347EB90 adds one component per entity of a HashMap and copy-assigns the map's 48-byte HashSet value (stride 0x30) into it. Never seen alive. Registry total 48 (server row).

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x348BF30 (AllocRaw 0x30) zeroes +0..+0x2F in the HashSet pattern; destructor thunk of bg3.exe+0x582AD0 frees +0x20, +0x10, +0 (trivial keys). Writer bg3.exe+0x347EB90 lines 356-358: FUN_141008810(component, value) copy-assigns a HashSet; its key copy bg3.exe+0x10092E0 moves 8-byte keys. EntityHandle is the likely key type (inventory members), not proven. Second pass: bg3.exe+0x347EB90 lines 160-161 fill a local HashMap keyed by the 8-byte value at +8 of an interaction record and insert the 8-byte value at +0 of the same record into the value set with FUN_140721030 (HashSet insert, keys compared as one 8-byte value, key stride 8); lines 358-361 create the component per map key with bg3.exe+0x348BF30 and copy the 48-byte set into it with FUN_141008810 (key array copied 8 bytes per element by FUN_1410092E0).

open_questions: Key type: 8-byte values taken from inventory interaction records (entity handles by context); no hash function other than plain modulo is involved, so EntityHandle vs uint64 is not distinguishable from the code - EntityHandle kept.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
